Name: A Great Flower Dance
Author: comfemshep
Description:
This mod makes multiple changes to the Flower Dance events.

All included characters can now dance in either row, some characters who previously didn't participate now can, pairs are randomised with some being more likely than others.

You can use the mod with Vanilla, Seasonal Bachu and Seasonal Cute Outfits Sprites.

New Dancers included: (NOTE: This also lets you ask the characters to dance with you.)
- Robin
- Demetrius
- Caroline
- Pierre

Preferred pairings include the vanilla game pairings, married couples for the new dancers, characters who are friends, family members, etc. but theoretically almost anyone can end up dancing together.




[b]INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS[/b]

1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41182]JP's The Flower Dance Mod[/url]
2. Configure this mod to how many dancers you'd like. (Default is 6 pairs. This will be just the marriage candidates)
3. Download the core mod.
4. Put it in your Mods folder.
DONE

[i]Optional: For Seasonal Cute Character Compatibility[/i]
5. Download the Compatibility File.
6. Put it in your mod folder and let it overwrite the files it wants to.




[b]Future Plans[/b]
- adding even more dancers (Evelyn/George, Kent/Jodi, Jas/Vincent)
- making the mod more configurable
- adding options to give dresses and suits for characters who don't have them



If there are other Sprites you'd like me to make compatible, feel free to ask. However the Sprite assets must either be free to use (According to the mod author's Permissions page) or your own.



Note: If you just want the marriage candidates to dance in either Row (and wear different outfits) you can download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42302]this mod[/url] instead.
